method.build: uv pip install . pytest asgiref greenlet python-dotenv blinker (network), then python -c 'import flask' in docker --network none
method.decision_rule: GO iff BUILT_AND_TESTED share >= 50% and no FLAKY
method.dependency_resolution: uv pip install --exclude-newer <commit time>: every package as published by the commit time
method.not_covered: examples and docs tests; type checks
method.test: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests in docker --network none, environment read-only, repeated 2x
method.toolchain_rule: CPython minor released >=14 days before the commit date, at least 3.8 (uv's floor), raised to requires-python; image python:<minor> with uv 0.9.2
